questions.stem: Epithelial mesenchymal transmission induced by which pair of transcription factors?
questions.solutionHtml:
SNAIL & TWIST

questions.stem: What is the mutation seen in Sickle cell anemia?
questions.solutionHtml:
Glu ---> Val (6)
  • It’s a missense point mutation there is substitution of glutamic acid by valine in the 6th position, the beta globin chain of hemoglobin. It alters the solubility or stability of the hemoglobin and produces hemolytic anemia.
